method: OpenAI built-in image_gen; two separate generation calls
displayDisclosure: Immagini illustrative generate con AI. Non sono fotografie dei piatti serviti.

The images do not establish recipes, nutritional values, food sourcing, dietary suitability, certifications or absence of cross-contamination.

Retain generated sources; optimize copies for web delivery if needed.
